Fixture: the rule no-suite-source-header in .github/invariants.txt has to match
nothing in this file.

Each line below is legal text sitting close enough to the violation that a rule
written slightly too wide would take it. A rule that refuses the correct
spelling beside the violation is a rule whoever meets it turns off, and then it
refuses nothing at all.

    for detail see the LICENSE text file
    This file is part of the reissbrett distribution and orchestration layer
    Copyright (c) 2026 the reissbrett contributors
    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
    The suite spells its licence file one way and this repository spells its own
    file the other way, which is the whole of the difference on the first line.

The first line is the one worth having. This repository's own licence file is
spelled with an S and the suite spells its own with a C, so the two sentences
are one character apart, and the C is the character that says a file came from
somewhere else. A rule reaching for either spelling would be red on the day it
landed, on this repository's own notices.

The second line is the other direction. A banner naming this project rather than
the suite is what a file written here carries, and refusing it would make the
rule an obstacle to the ordinary case rather than to the one it is about.
